mapper.select: SELECT to_regclass('catalog_projection_schema')::text
SELECT set_config('recsys.catalog.projection.digest',#{digest},true)
SELECT script_sha256 FROM catalog_projection_schema WHERE version=1
mapper.update: SET LOCAL lock_timeout='4s'; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s'
mapper.select: SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(1730041701)
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE ad_servable,ad_embedding IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT set_config('recsys.catalog.projection.writer','v1',true)
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(#{adId})
SELECT source_id,cluster_id,topic_id,topic_name,group_id,state,worker_id,fence,lease_until FROM catalog_projection_control WHERE singleton=true
SELECT partition_id,start_offset,next_offset FROM catalog_projection_position ORDER BY partition_id
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_projection_control SET state='RUNNING',worker_id=#{worker},fence=fence+1, lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE singleton=true AND (state='READY' OR (state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp()))

UPDATE catalog_projection_control SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE singleton=true AND state='RUNNING' AND worker_id=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_projection_control WHERE singleton=true AND state='RUNNING' AND worker_id=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_projection_control SET state='PAUSED',error_code=#{code},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE singleton=true AND worker_id=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence}
UPDATE catalog_projection_control SET state='READY',worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code=NULL, updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE singleton=true AND state='PAUSED'
UPDATE catalog_projection_control SET state='READY',worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE singleton=true AND state='RUNNING' AND worker_id=#{worker} AND fence=#{fence}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ad_servable)+(SELECT count(*) FROM ad_embedding)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_projection_receipt(partition_id,record_offset,record_key,payload,digest,state) VALUES(#{receipt.partitionId},#{receipt.recordOffset},#{receipt.recordKey,jdbcType=BINARY},#{receipt.payload,jdbcType=BINARY},#{receipt.digest},'READY') ON CONFLICT(partition_id,record_offset) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT partition_id,record_offset,record_key,payload,digest,state,attempts,error_code FROM catalog_projection_receipt WHERE partition_id=#{partition} AND record_offset=#{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_projection_receipt SET attempts=attempts+1 WHERE partition_id=#{partition} AND record_offset=#{offset} AND attempts<3 AND state='READY'
UPDATE catalog_projection_receipt SET state=#{state},error_code=#{code,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE partition_id=#{partition} AND record_offset=#{offset} AND state='READY'
UPDATE catalog_projection_receipt SET attempts=0 WHERE state='READY'
UPDATE catalog_projection_receipt SET state='READY' WHERE partition_id=#{partition} AND record_offset=#{offset} AND state='QUARANTINED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_embedding(ad_id,embedding,model) VALUES(#{adId},CAST(#{vector} AS vector),#{model}) ON CONFLICT(ad_id) DO UPDATE SET embedding=EXCLUDED.embedding,model=EXCLUDED.model
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_projection_position SET next_offset=#{offset}+1 WHERE partition_id=#{partition} AND next_offset=#{offset}
mapper.select: SELECT ad_id,source_id,aggregate_version,digest,payload,embedding_payload,item_id,deleted FROM catalog_projection WHERE ad_id=#{adId}
SELECT digest FROM catalog_projection_inbox WHERE event_id=#{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_projection(ad_id,source_id,aggregate_version,digest,payload,embedding_payload,item_id,deleted) VALUES(#{projection.adId},#{projection.sourceId},#{projection.aggregateVersion},#{projection.digest},#{projection.payload},#{projection.embeddingPayload,jdbcType=BINARY},#{projection.itemId,jdbcType=BIGINT},#{projection.deleted}) ON CONFLICT(ad_id) DO UPDATE SET aggregate_version=EXCLUDED.aggregate_version,digest=EXCLUDED.digest,payload=EXCLUDED.payload, embedding_payload=EXCLUDED.embedding_payload,item_id=EXCLUDED.item_id,deleted=EXCLUDED.deleted,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE catalog_projection.source_id=EXCLUDED.source_id AND catalog_projection.aggregate_version<EXCLUDED.aggregate_version
mapper.select: INSERT INTO catalog_projection_redis_task(ad_id,aggregate_version,old_payload,payload) VALUES(#{adId},#{version},#{oldPayload,jdbcType=BINARY},#{payload}) RETURNING task_id
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_projection_redis_task SET state='PAUSED',error_code='ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE task_id IN (SELECT task_id FROM catalog_projection_redis_task WHERE state='RUNNING' AND attempts>=3 AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp() ORDER BY task_id LIMIT 10 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS (SELECT t.task_id FROM catalog_projection_redis_task t WHERE t.attempts<3 AND ((t.state='READY' AND t.available_at<=clock_timestamp()) OR (t.state='RUNNING' AND t.lease_until<=clock_timestamp())) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_projection_redis_task earlier WHERE earlier.ad_id=t.ad_id AND earlier.task_id<t.task_id AND earlier.state<>'DONE') ORDER BY t.available_at,t.task_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE catalog_projection_redis_task t SET state='RUNNING',attempts=attempts+1,fence=fence+1, lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM candidate c WHERE t.task_id=c.task_id RETURNING t.task_id,t.ad_id,t.aggregate_version,t.old_payload,t.payload,t.state,t.attempts,t.fence,t.lease_until
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_projection_redis_task SET state='DONE',error_code=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE task_id=#{id} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE catalog_projection_redis_task SET state=CASE WHEN attempts>=3 THEN 'PAUSED' ELSE 'READY' END, error_code=#{code},available_at=clock_timestamp()+(power(2,attempts-1)+(task_id%10)*0.01)*interval '1 second',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE task_id=#{id} AND fence=#{fence} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT task_id,ad_id,aggregate_version,old_payload,payload,state,attempts,fence,lease_until FROM catalog_projection_redis_task WHERE task_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_projection_redis_task SET state='READY',attempts=0,available_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE task_id=#{id} AND state='PAUSED'
mapper.select: SELECT command_id,kind,target,actor,reason,result_id FROM catalog_projection_audit WHERE command_id=#{id}
SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_projection_redis_task WHERE state=#{state}
SELECT count(*) FROM catalog_projection_receipt WHERE state='QUARANTINED'
SELECT COALESCE(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-min(created_at)),0) FROM catalog_projection_redis_task WHERE state<>'DONE'
